attempts.summary: Configured a persistent firewalld host firewall on node1 (RHEL 7.9): SSH allowed from any address, TCP/9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.8.11), and TCP/9000 rejected from node3 (10.100.8.12) and everywhere else. Verified behavior with live traffic, then restarted all three managed nodes one at a time, confirming boot-identity changes and post-reboot recovery of the firewall config and correct traffic behavior on each.
